body_es: `git reflog` registra todos los movimientos del HEAD, permitiendo recuperar trabajo que parecía perdido. Es una red de seguridad cuando accidentalmente resets o rebases eliminan commits. Los hooks de Git son scripts que se ejecutan automáticamente en eventos como commits o pushes. Los hooks pre-commit pueden validar código; los hooks post-commit pueden enviar notificaciones. Se guardan en `.git/hooks/` y permiten automatizar workflows.
body_en: `git reflog` records all HEAD movements, allowing you to recover work that seemed lost. It is a safety net when accidental resets or rebases delete commits. Git hooks are scripts that run automatically on events like commits or pushes. Pre-commit hooks can validate code; post-commit hooks can send notifications. They are stored in `.git/hooks/` and allow workflow automation.
example_code:
git reflog
git reset --hard 5x6y7z8
git reflog
# View hooks
ls -la .git/hooks/
cat .git/hooks/pre-commit
example_output:
5x6y7z8 HEAD@{0}: reset: moving to 5x6y7z8
9k0l1m2 HEAD@{1}: commit: Fix critical bug
4a5b6c7 HEAD@{2}: checkout: moving from develop to master

-rwxr-xr-x 1 user user  452 Sep 24 10:30 pre-commit
-rwxr-xr-x 1 user user  189 Sep 24 10:30 pre-push
-rwxr-xr-x 1 user user  224 Sep 24 10:30 commit-msg
